title: Jump Game
statement:
You stand on the first spot of a list of whole numbers. Each number is the longest jump you can make from its spot: from a `3` you can move forward 1, 2, or 3 spots, and from a `0` you can't move at all. Decide whether you can reach the last spot.

The first line is the count `n`, at least 1. The second line has the `n` numbers, each 0 or more, separated by spaces. Print `true` when some series of jumps reaches the last spot and `false` otherwise. A list of one number starts on the last spot, so it prints `true`.

Input:

```text
5
2 3 1 1 4
```

Expected output:

```text
true
```

Jump 1 spot to the `3`, then 3 spots to the end.
hints: Trying every series of jumps takes far too long. You only need to know how far along the list you could get.
Walk the list from the start and keep the farthest index you can reach so far. From index `i`, a jump reaches up to `i + nums[i]`.
If the walk arrives at an index past that farthest point, no jump can get you there, and you are stuck.
